title: Transmission patterns and future forecasting of mpox: a review of mathematical modelling approaches for prediction and public health preparedness
abstract: Abstract Mpox has shifted from a disease mainly associated with zoonotic spillover in Central and West Africa to a recurrent global public-health threat involving sexual-contact networks, household transmission, international mobility, ecological persistence and clade-specific uncertainty. Mathematical models have clarified important mechanisms in the 2022 clade IIb outbreak, including the role of heavy-tailed sexual-contact distributions, behavioural adaptation, vaccination and case isolation. However, the literature remains less mature in one respect that is essential for preparedness: the conversion of transmission insight into reliable, setting-specific forecasts. This narrative review synthesizes peer-reviewed modelling evidence on mpox transmission patterns and evaluates the extent to which existing compartmental, stochastic, network, agent-based, phylodynamic and time-series models support future outbreak prediction. The review identifies four recurring gaps: insufficient prospective validation, weak integration of spatial and cross-regional lags, limited clade-specific parameterization for clade I/Ib risk, and inadequate incorporation of immunity, reporting delay and surveillance uncertainty. We propose a forecasting-oriented framework that links epidemiological state variables, contact structure, population immunity, mobility, interventions and uncertainty quantification to decision-relevant outputs. The novelty of this review lies in repositioning mpox modelling from retrospective explanation toward predictive readiness. A forecasting-first approach can strengthen early warning, targeted vaccination, communication planning and health-system preparedness, particularly in settings where surveillance is delayed, incomplete or geographically fragmented.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the transmission patterns and forecasting capabilities of the mpox virus, emphasizing its shift from a zoonotic disease in Central and West Africa to a global public health threat. The analysis highlights the role of sexual-contact networks, household transmission, international mobility, and ecological persistence in shaping mpox dynamics. Mathematical models have provided insights into mechanisms such as heavy-tailed sexual-contact distributions, behavioral adaptation, vaccination, and case isolation during the 2022 clade IIb outbreak. However, the literature lacks mature methods for converting transmission insights into reliable, setting-specific forecasts. The review identifies key gaps, including insufficient prospective validation, weak spatial integration, limited clade-specific parameterization, and inadequate incorporation of immunity and surveillance uncertainty. It proposes a forecasting-oriented framework that links epidemiological variables to decision-relevant outputs. The implications of this work suggest that a forecasting-first approach could enhance early warning systems, targeted vaccination strategies, communication planning, and health system preparedness, especially in areas with fragmented or delayed surveillance.

title: Manifestations of Mpox in Males: An Australian Case Series
abstract: Abstract Background Mpox commonly presents with anogenital lesions, creating diagnostic overlap with other causes of male genital ulceration, pustulation and oedema. Recognition is particularly relevant for clinicians assessing penile, perianal or proctitic symptoms, where delayed diagnosis may result in complications and transmission. Objectives To describe the male genital and anogenital manifestations of mpox in an Australian case series, including lesion morphology, co-infections, diagnostic pitfalls and complications relevant to male genital dermatology. Methods We performed a retrospective review of 50 consecutive adults who presented to local health services between 15 July 2023 and 1 October 2025 and tested positive for mpox by nucleic acid amplification testing. Clinical notes, pathology results, immunisation records and available lesion photographs were reviewed. This analysis emphasises male genital and anogenital findings. Results All patients were men who have sex with men, with a mean age of 38.6 years. The anogenital region was the most frequently involved anatomical area: penile swabs were positive in 25/50 patients (50%) and rectal swabs in 14/50 (28%). Presentations included penile lesions, perianal or rectal symptoms, proctitis, localised penile or perianal swelling and, in five patients, rectal mpox detected despite no visible external lesions. Lesions were described as pustular, ulcerated, crusted, papular, vesicular, erosive or exudative, and were variably painful, painless or pruritic. Differential diagnoses included primary syphilis, genital herpes simplex virus, molluscum contagiosum and folliculitis. Ten patients had concurrent sexually transmitted infections, including one lesion positive for both mpox and herpes simplex virus and one lesion positive for both mpox and syphilis. Five patients required hospital admission; male genital complications included severe proctitis, sepsis with concurrent sexually transmitted infection, penile swelling, chronic penile ulceration and urinary retention requiring catheterisation. Conclusions Mpox is an important cause of male genital and anogenital disease. In this cohort it most often presented as acute penile or rectal disease, but could mimic more common sexually transmitted infections or, rarely, a chronic penile ulcer requiring biopsy to exclude malignancy. Male genital dermatology services should consider mpox in new penile, perianal or proctitic presentations in at-risk men, particularly where lesions are pustular, ulcerated, exudative or associated with oedema, lymphadenopathy or concurrent sexually transmitted infection.

title: The Brighton collaboration standardized module for mpox vaccines, MVA-BN and LC16m8, benefit-risk assessment
abstract: Based on the rapidly evolving multi-country outbreak in Africa, WHO declared mpox a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) from August 2024 to September 2025. In this outbreak, to date, over 100,000 suspected mpox cases and 1700 deaths have been reported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The MVA-BN and LC16m8 mpox vaccines have been recommended by WHO, the MVA-BN vaccine was WHO prequalified and the first shipment of donated vaccine arrived in DRC in Sept 2024. DRC launched the first phase of the mpox vaccination campaign in October 2024 with the MVA-BN vaccine and both vaccines have been used to help control the outbreak. The benefit-risk assessment (BRA) for the MVA-BN and LC16m8 mpox vaccines on "Myocarditis following MVA-BN, and the LC16m8 Mpox vaccines: A Case Study based on global data" was prepared by the authors on an urgent basis for the DRC national regulatory authority, the Congolese Pharmaceutical Regulatory Authority (ACOREP), in September 2024. The module was developed to help guide the utilization of the donated mpox vaccines in DRC and was prepared utilizing publicly available data from epidemiological studies, clinical trials, post-marketing studies and real-world evidence. The analysis was conducted for all WHO recommended schedules for the vaccines, including the MVA-BN vaccine administered subcutaneously and intradermally (as a dose-sparing option), for pre- and post-exposure prophylaxis, for adults and immunocompromised adults and LC16m8 vaccine administered to adults. The BRA was repeated in 2026 as there was additional data on the vaccines available. The base case of mpox incidence in the updated analysis was the annualized incidence of mpox reported in DRC from January 2024 through March 2025 (from the beginning to the main peak of the epidemic in DRC). High and low incidence were 10 x and 1/10 of the base rate, respectively, incidence rates that were considered so that the BRA is useful for different incidence rates during the outbreak, among different risk groups, and for different regions of the country. The results of the analysis were similar. The benefits of the MVA-BN vaccine administered subcutaneously or intradermally, for pre- and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), for children and adults, including immunocompromised individuals and one dose of LC16m8 vaccine administered to >1 year of age strongly outweighed the risks for the base and base x 10 incidence rates and marginally for the base/10 incidence rate. The updated analysis is presented in this publication.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a benefit-risk assessment (BRA) for the MVA-BN and LC16m8 mpox vaccines, developed to guide their use in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) during a rapidly evolving mpox outbreak. The analysis was based on publicly available data from epidemiological studies, clinical trials, post-marketing studies, and real-world evidence. The study reports over 100,000 suspected mpox cases and 1700 deaths in the DRC from January 2024 through March 2025. The BRA was conducted for various vaccine schedules, including subcutaneous and intradermal administration of MVA-BN and the use of LC16m8 in adults. The results indicate that the benefits of the vaccines strongly outweigh the risks for the base and base x 10 incidence rates, and marginally for the base/10 incidence rate. The findings are relevant for vaccine utilization in the DRC and for different risk groups and regions. The analysis was repeated in 2026 due to additional data availability, and the results remained consistent.

title_zh: 布莱顿协作标准化模块 猴痘 疫苗、MVA-BN 和 LC16m8、效益-风险评估
source_body_en: Based on the rapidly evolving multi-country outbreak in Africa, WHO declared mpox a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) from August 2024 to September 2025. In this outbreak, to date, over 100,000 suspected mpox cases and 1700 deaths have been reported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The MVA-BN and LC16m8 mpox vaccines have been recommended by WHO, the MVA-BN vaccine was WHO prequalified and the first shipment of donated vaccine arrived in DRC in Sept 2024. DRC launched the first phase of the mpox vaccination campaign in October 2024 with the MVA-BN vaccine and both vaccines have been used to help control the outbreak. The benefit-risk assessment (BRA) for the MVA-BN and LC16m8 mpox vaccines on "Myocarditis following MVA-BN, and the LC16m8 Mpox vaccines: A Case Study based on global data" was prepared by the authors on an urgent basis for the DRC national regulatory authority, the Congolese Pharmaceutical Regulatory Authority (ACOREP), in September 2024. The module was developed to help guide the utilization of the donated mpox vaccines in DRC and was prepared utilizing publicly available data from epidemiological studies, clinical trials, post-marketing studies and real-world evidence. The analysis was conducted for all WHO recommended schedules for the vaccines, including the MVA-BN vaccine administered subcutaneously and intradermally (as a dose-sparing option), for pre- and post-exposure prophylaxis, for adults and immunocompromised adults and LC16m8 vaccine administered to adults. The BRA was repeated in 2026 as there was additional data on the vaccines available. The base case of mpox incidence in the updated analysis was the annualized incidence of mpox reported in DRC from January 2024 through March 2025 (from the beginning to the main peak of the epidemic in DRC). High and low incidence were 10 x and 1/10 of the base rate, respectively, incidence rates that were considered so that the BRA is useful for different incidence rates during the outbreak, among different risk groups, and for different regions of the country. The results of the analysis were similar. The benefits of the MVA-BN vaccine administered subcutaneously or intradermally, for pre- and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), for children and adults, including immunocompromised individuals and one dose of LC16m8 vaccine administered to >1 year of age strongly outweighed the risks for the base and base x 10 incidence rates and marginally for the base/10 incidence rate. The updated analysis is presented in this publication.
abstract_zh: 基于非洲多国快速演变的暴发疫情,世界卫生组织(WHO)于2024年8月至2025年9月宣布猴痘为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件(PHEIC)。截至目前,刚果民主共和国(DRC)报告了超过100,000例疑似猴痘病例和1700例死亡。WHO推荐了MVA-BN和LC16m8 猴痘疫苗,其中MVA-BN疫苗已获得WHO预认证,首批捐赠的疫苗疫苗于2024年9月抵达DRC。DRC于2024年10月启动了猴痘疫苗接种活动的第一阶段,使用MVA-BN疫苗,并且两种疫苗均被用于帮助控制暴发疫情。关于MVA-BN和LC16m8 猴痘疫苗的益处-风险评估(BRA)由作者于2024年9月紧急准备,供DRC国家监管机构刚果制药监管局(ACOREP)参考。该模块旨在指导在DRC使用捐赠疫苗,并利用流行病学研究、临床试验、上市后研究和真实世界证据等公开数据进行准备。分析涵盖了WHO推荐的所有疫苗疫苗接种方案,包括MVA-BN疫苗的皮下和皮内接种(作为剂量节省选项),用于暴露前和暴露后预防(PEP),适用于儿童和成人,包括免疫功能低下者,以及LC16m8疫苗用于成人。由于有更多关于疫苗疫苗的数据,2026年再次进行了BRA分析。在更新的分析中,猴痘疫苗的基线病例数是DRC从2024年1月至2025年3月报告的猴痘年化发病率。高和低的发病率分别为基线的10倍和1/10,这些发病率被考虑用于不同疫情阶段、不同风险群体和地区。分析结果相似。对于基线和基线的10倍发病率,MVA-BN疫苗的皮下或皮内接种,以及用于暴露前和暴露后预防(PEP)的儿童和成人,包括免疫功能低下者,以及LC16m8疫苗用于1岁以上人群的单剂量接种,其益处明显超过了风险,甚至在基线的1/10发病率下也仅略微超过风险。更新的分析结果在本文中呈现。

title: Genomic Characterization and Molecular Evolutionary Analysis of Monkeypox Virus in Qinghai, China, 2025
abstract: Abstract Monkeypox virus (MPXV) lineage E.4 has emerged as the predominant strain in Asia, however, genomic data from northwestern China remains scarce. In this study, we performed comprehensive genomic, phylodynamic, and structural analyses of three newly identified MPXV isolates obtained from confirmed cases in Qinghai Province, China, between June and September 2025. Whole-genome sequencing, optimally performed on vesicular fluid owing to peak viral loads—confirmed that all isolates belong to Clade IIb, lineage E.4, and form a tight monophyletic cluster with contemporary strains from Japan. Bayesian phylodynamic reconstruction yielded a mean evolutionary rate of \(\:4.186\times\:{10}^{-5}\) substitutions per site per year and revealed a rapid population expansion between June and September 2025, coinciding with the regional rise of the E.4 lineage. Notably, mutational profiling uncovered a distinctive “core conserved, terminal differentiated” pattern. Although all isolates shared 11 signature mutations, substantial sample-specific heterogeneity—including eight unique mutations restricted to a single isolate—strongly suggest multiple independent introductions into Qinghai through a cryptic transmission network, rather than a single localized outbreak. In silico predictions further identified OPG102:T150I and OPG092:E155K as highly deleterious mutations that severely destabilize protein structure (ΔΔG = − 0.64 and − 0.13 kcal/mol, respectively). We hypothesize that these structural perturbations represent adaptive fitness trade-offs that may prioritize conformational flexibility or immune evasion. Collectively, these findings underscore the critical need for high-resolution genomic surveillance, integrated with structural bioinformatics, to decipher the ongoing microevolution of MPXV.

source_records.abstract: Abstract Monkeypox virus (MPXV) lineage E.4 has emerged as the predominant strain in Asia, however, genomic data from northwestern China remains scarce. In this study, we performed comprehensive genomic, phylodynamic, and structural analyses of three newly identified MPXV isolates obtained from confirmed cases in Qinghai Province, China, between June and September 2025. Whole-genome sequencing, optimally performed on vesicular fluid owing to peak viral loads—confirmed that all isolates belong to Clade IIb, lineage E.4, and form a tight monophyletic cluster with contemporary strains from Japan. Bayesian phylodynamic reconstruction yielded a mean evolutionary rate of \(\:4.186\times\:{10}^{-5}\) substitutions per site per year and revealed a rapid population expansion between June and September 2025, coinciding with the regional rise of the E.4 lineage. Notably, mutational profiling uncovered a distinctive “core conserved, terminal differentiated” pattern. Although all isolates shared 11 signature mutations, substantial sample-specific heterogeneity—including eight unique mutations restricted to a single isolate—strongly suggest multiple independent introductions into Qinghai through a cryptic transmission network, rather than a single localized outbreak. In silico predictions further identified OPG102:T150I and OPG092:E155K as highly deleterious mutations that severely destabilize protein structure (ΔΔG = − 0.64 and − 0.13 kcal/mol, respectively). We hypothesize that these structural perturbations represent adaptive fitness trade-offs that may prioritize conformational flexibility or immune evasion. Collectively, these findings underscore the critical need for high-resolution genomic surveillance, integrated with structural bioinformatics, to decipher the ongoing microevolution of MPXV.

abstract_zh: 摘要 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) E.4 系已成为亚洲的主要毒株,但中国西北部的基因组数据仍然匮乏。在这项研究中,我们对 2025 年 6 月至 9 月期间从中国青海省确诊病例中获得的三种新鉴定的 MPXV 分离株进行了全面的基因组、系统动力学和结构分析。全 基因组 测序(由于病毒载量达到峰值,在水泡液上进行了最佳测序)证实所有分离株均属于进化枝 IIb,谱系 E.4,并与来自日本的当代毒株形成紧密的单系群。贝叶斯系统动力学重建得出每个位点每年的平均进化速率为 \(\:4.186\times\:{10}^{-5}\) 替换,并揭示了 2025 年 6 月至 9 月期间种群的快速扩张,与 E.4 谱系的区域崛起相一致。值得注意的是,突变分析揭示了一种独特的“核心保守、末端分化”模式。尽管所有分离株共享 11 个特征 突变,但显着的样本特异性异质性(包括仅限于单个分离株的 8 个独特的 突变)强烈表明通过神秘的 传播 网络而不是单个本地化的 暴发 多次独立引入青海。计算机预测进一步确定 OPG102:T150I 和 OPG092:E155K 是高度有害的 突变,会严重破坏蛋白质结构的稳定性(ΔΔG 分别 = − 0.64 和 − 0.13 kcal/mol)。我们假设这些结构扰动代表了适应性适应性权衡,可能会优先考虑构象灵活性或免疫逃避。总的来说,这些发现强调了对高分辨率 基因组监测 与结构生物信息学相结合的迫切需要,以破译 MPXV 正在进行的微进化。

title: Epidemiological models in health misinformation propagation of Mpox conversations
abstract: The rapid dissemination of health misinformation through digital platforms poses significant challenges to public health communication and response strategies. The spread of misinformation can be likened to the spread of diseases within communities during an epidemic. This study addresses the question around how the classical SIR (Susceptible-Infectious-Recovered) and adapted SEIR (Susceptible-Exposed-Infectious-Recovered) epidemiological models compare in their abilities to capture the temporal dynamics of health misinformation spread on social media platforms during disease outbreaks. Using the 2022 Mpox outbreak as a case study, we analyse a publicly available dataset of 5,787 tweets collected between 7–13 July 2022, with the vast majority posted on a single day (9 July 2022). Given the narrow temporal window and concentrated activity in this dataset, we frame our study as a proof-of-concept illustrating how compartmental models can be adapted to short-horizon social media bursts, rather than a definitive epidemiological characterisation of Mpox misinformation. Within this scope, our comparative analysis shows that the SIR model effectively captures rapid initial dissemination patterns characteristic of viral misinformation spread, whilst the SEIR model more accurately represents the latency period between exposure and active sharing behaviour observed in social media contexts. We report explicit parameter values ( β , γ , σ ), discuss their sensitivity and identifiability limits under the short observation window, and highlight the restrictions imposed by the homogeneous-mixing assumption. These findings contribute methodological insights for compartmental model selection in misinformation research and motivate future work with larger, longitudinally collected datasets.

abstract_zh: 通过数字平台快速传播健康错误信息给公共卫生沟通和应对策略带来了重大挑战。错误信息的传播可以比作流行病期间疾病在社区内的传播。本研究解决了经典 SIR(易感-感染-恢复)和改编后的 SEIR(易感-暴露-感染-恢复)流行病学模型如何比较捕获疾病期间社交媒体平台上传播的健康错误信息的时间动态的问题。我们以 2022 年 猴痘 暴发 作为案例研究,分析了 2022 年 7 月 7 日至 13 日期间收集的 5,787 条推文的公开数据集,其中绝大多数是在一天(2022 年 7 月 9 日)发布的。考虑到该数据集中的狭窄时间窗口和集中的活动,我们将我们的研究视为概念验证,说明分区模型如何适应短期社交媒体爆发,而不是 猴痘 错误信息的明确流行病学特征。在此范围内,我们的比较分析表明,SIR 模型有效地捕捉了病毒式错误信息传播的快速初始传播模式特征,而 SEIR 模型更准确地代表了社交媒体环境中观察到的曝光和主动分享行为之间的潜伏期。我们报告显式参数值(β、γ、σ),讨论它们在短观察窗口下的敏感性和可识别性限制,并强调均匀混合假设所施加的限制。这些发现为错误信息研究中的分区模型选择提供了方法论见解,并激励未来使用更大的纵向收集的数据集进行工作。

title: Knowledge, attitude, and behaviours concerning mpox from an online survey among MSM in the Eastern Mediterranean Region (EMR)
abstract: BACKGROUND: Human monkeypox (mpox), a viral zoonotic infectious disease, was declared a public health emergency of international concern. Men who have sex with men (MSM) were most affected by mpox during the global outbreak. This study aimed to assess the knowledge, attitudes, and behaviours concerning mpox among the MSM population in the Eastern Mediterranean Region (EMR). METHODS: This was a cross-sectional study of MSM residing in countries of the EMR. Participants were recruited through non-governmental organisations, dating applications, and LGBTQ+ websites between July and October 2023. Data on behaviours, perceptions, access to healthcare, socio-demographics, and medical characteristics related to mpox were collected online via LimeSurvey. The outcome was high mpox knowledge whereby a score greater than 12 of 17 was considered as high mpox knowledge score. Adaptive Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator logistic regression was used to predict participants' knowledge about mpox. Model discrimination and calibration were assessed. RESULTS: A total of 643 MSM participants of median age 31 (IQR:26-37) were included in the study. Among study participants, 131 (20.4%) had high mpox knowledge. Key predictors of high mpox knowledge score were being 31-40 years old, employed, in a relationship, thinking mpox vaccine is safe, and knowing someone infected with mpox. The model had good discrimination AUC = 0.812 (95%CI:0.77-0.85) and calibration C-slope = 1.073 (95%CI:0.87-1.27). CONCLUSION: This study identified gaps and predictors of high mpox knowledge score among MSM in the EMR. These findings provide new insights needed to raise awareness and inform targeted public health interventions to reduce the spread of mpox.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人猴痘(猴痘)是一种病毒性人畜共患传染病,被宣布为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。在全球 暴发 期间,男男性行为者 (MSM) 受 猴痘 的影响最大。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项针对居住在东地中海地区 (EMR) 国家的 MSM 的横断面研究。参与者是在 2023 年 7 月至 10 月期间通过非政府组织、约会应用程序和 LGBTQ+ 网站招募的。该研究共有 643 名中位年龄为 31 岁(IQR:26-37)的 MSM 参与者。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 LimeSurvey 在线收集与 猴痘 相关的行为、观念、医疗保健获取、社会人口统计和医疗特征的数据。自适应最小绝对收缩和选择算子逻辑回归用于预测参与者关于 猴痘 的知识。评估了模型辨别力和校准。
elements_zh.main_results: 在研究参与者中,131 人(20.4%)具有较高的 猴痘 知识。猴痘 知识得分高的关键预测因素是年龄在 31-40 岁、有工作、有恋爱关系、认为 猴痘 疫苗 是安全的、并且认识感染 猴痘 的人。该模型具有良好的辨别力 AUC = 0.812 (95%CI:0.77-0.85) 和校准 C 斜率 = 1.073 (95%CI:0.87-1.27)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究确定了 EMR 中 MSM 知识得分高的差距和预测因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了提高认识和为有针对性的公共卫生干预措施提供信息所需的新见解,以减少 猴痘 的传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据并未报告该研究的具体局限性。

title_zh: 东地中海地区 MSM 在线调查 (EMR) 有关 猴痘 的知识、态度和行为
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Human monkeypox (mpox), a viral zoonotic infectious disease, was declared a public health emergency of international concern. Men who have sex with men (MSM) were most affected by mpox during the global outbreak. This study aimed to assess the knowledge, attitudes, and behaviours concerning mpox among the MSM population in the Eastern Mediterranean Region (EMR). METHODS: This was a cross-sectional study of MSM residing in countries of the EMR. Participants were recruited through non-governmental organisations, dating applications, and LGBTQ+ websites between July and October 2023. Data on behaviours, perceptions, access to healthcare, socio-demographics, and medical characteristics related to mpox were collected online via LimeSurvey. The outcome was high mpox knowledge whereby a score greater than 12 of 17 was considered as high mpox knowledge score. Adaptive Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator logistic regression was used to predict participants' knowledge about mpox. Model discrimination and calibration were assessed. RESULTS: A total of 643 MSM participants of median age 31 (IQR:26-37) were included in the study. Among study participants, 131 (20.4%) had high mpox knowledge. Key predictors of high mpox knowledge score were being 31-40 years old, employed, in a relationship, thinking mpox vaccine is safe, and knowing someone infected with mpox. The model had good discrimination AUC = 0.812 (95%CI:0.77-0.85) and calibration C-slope = 1.073 (95%CI:0.87-1.27). CONCLUSION: This study identified gaps and predictors of high mpox knowledge score among MSM in the EMR. These findings provide new insights needed to raise awareness and inform targeted public health interventions to reduce the spread of mpox.

title: Safety and immunogenicity of the LC16m8 vaccine against mpox during outbreak deployment in Colombia: a hybrid, multicentre, open-label, randomised controlled trial and observational cohort study
abstract: BACKGROUND: LC16m8 is a live-attenuated, replication-competent vaccinia vaccine, but clinical evidence on its efficacy against mpox remains limited. We assessed its efficacy and safety in adults at increased risk of mpox in Colombia. METHODS: We conducted a hybrid study comprising a multicentre, open-label, randomised delayed-vaccination trial and an observational cohort at three centres in Bogotá. Adults aged 18-50 years were randomised 1:1 using stratified permuted blocks to receive one percutaneous dose of LC16m8 at enrolment (Day 0) or on Day 42. The primary outcome was PCR-confirmed mpox during the arm-specific efficacy-assessment windows, analysed in the per-protocol efficacy population; no efficacy outcomes were imputed. Safety outcomes were assessed through Day 180. CLINICALTRIALS: govNCT06223919; retrospectively registered; trial closed to recruitment. FINDINGS: Between December 16, 2023, and January 6, 2024, 208 participants were enrolled and 204 randomised (104 immediate; 100 delayed); 203 were male and one female. The trial randomised 204 of 8686 planned participants. No PCR-confirmed mpox cases occurred in the primary per-protocol efficacy analysis (0/97 immediate vs 0/69 delayed); therefore, the prespecified hazard ratio, 95% CI, p value, and vaccine efficacy were not estimable. Through Day 180, at least one adverse event was reported by 96/98 (98·0%) participants in the immediate-vaccination group and 68/69 (98·6%) in the delayed-vaccination group. One serious adverse event occurred in each group; both were unrelated to vaccination and resolved. No deaths or adverse-event-related study discontinuations occurred. INTERPRETATION: Substantial under-recruitment and the absence of primary outcome events precluded estimation of LC16m8 efficacy. The randomised safety findings were limited by the small sample size. FUNDING: Japan Agency for Medical Research and Development (AMED; JP22fk0108503h0001); Ministry of Health and Social Protection of Colombia; Universidad Nacional de Colombia; National Institute of Health of Colombia.

title_zh: 在哥伦比亚部署 暴发 期间,LC16m8 疫苗 相对于 猴痘 的安全性和免疫原性:一项混合、多中心、开放标签、随机对照试验和观察性 队列研究 研究
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: LC16m8 is a live-attenuated, replication-competent vaccinia vaccine, but clinical evidence on its efficacy against mpox remains limited. We assessed its efficacy and safety in adults at increased risk of mpox in Colombia. METHODS: We conducted a hybrid study comprising a multicentre, open-label, randomised delayed-vaccination trial and an observational cohort at three centres in Bogotá. Adults aged 18-50 years were randomised 1:1 using stratified permuted blocks to receive one percutaneous dose of LC16m8 at enrolment (Day 0) or on Day 42. The primary outcome was PCR-confirmed mpox during the arm-specific efficacy-assessment windows, analysed in the per-protocol efficacy population; no efficacy outcomes were imputed. Safety outcomes were assessed through Day 180. CLINICALTRIALS: govNCT06223919; retrospectively registered; trial closed to recruitment. FINDINGS: Between December 16, 2023, and January 6, 2024, 208 participants were enrolled and 204 randomised (104 immediate; 100 delayed); 203 were male and one female. The trial randomised 204 of 8686 planned participants. No PCR-confirmed mpox cases occurred in the primary per-protocol efficacy analysis (0/97 immediate vs 0/69 delayed); therefore, the prespecified hazard ratio, 95% CI, p value, and vaccine efficacy were not estimable. Through Day 180, at least one adverse event was reported by 96/98 (98·0%) participants in the immediate-vaccination group and 68/69 (98·6%) in the delayed-vaccination group. One serious adverse event occurred in each group; both were unrelated to vaccination and resolved. No deaths or adverse-event-related study discontinuations occurred. INTERPRETATION: Substantial under-recruitment and the absence of primary outcome events precluded estimation of LC16m8 efficacy. The randomised safety findings were limited by the small sample size. FUNDING: Japan Agency for Medical Research and Development (AMED; JP22fk0108503h0001); Ministry of Health and Social Protection of Colombia; Universidad Nacional de Colombia; National Institute of Health of Colombia.

title: Determinants of mpox vaccine acceptance among peri-urban residents in Sekondi-Takoradi, Western Region of Ghana: A community-based cross-sectional study
abstract: Mpox re-emerged as a global public health concern in 2022, and the Western Region of Ghana became the epicentre of the country’s largest recorded outbreak in 2025. Ahead of a sub-national vaccination campaign launched in October 2025, no study had examined the determinants of mpox vaccine acceptance among peri-urban residents of the region using a theoretically grounded framework. This study determined the sociodemographic and Health Belief Model-based determinants of mpox vaccine acceptance among peri-urban residents of the Sekondi-Takoradi Metropolis, Western Region, Ghana. A community-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 580 adults in six purposively selected peri-urban areas and their surrounding communities between July and August 2025, before the vaccination campaign began. Vaccine acceptance was measured as a three-category outcome (accept, hesitant, refuse) and analysed using chi square tests and multinomial logistic regression adjusted for sociodemographic characteristics, Health Belief Model constructs, and peri-urban area. Overall, 75.7% of respondents were willing to accept the vaccine, 12.9% were hesitant and 11.4% would refuse. Perceived vaccine safety was the strongest determinant: respondents who considered the vaccine very safe had markedly lower adjusted odds of hesitancy (adjusted odds ratio 0.02, 95% confidence interval 0.00–0.12) and refusal (0.03, 0.01–0.13) than those who considered it unsafe. Uncertainty about vaccine effectiveness was associated with hesitancy (9.83, 1.95–49.50), and belief in its effectiveness with lower odds of refusal (0.22, 0.06–0.86). Higher educational attainment was associated with lower odds of hesitancy, being a student or employed with lower odds of refusal, and acceptance differed be 1 tween peri-urban areas (55.1% to 95.6%). Knowledge of mpox transmission was associated with acceptance in bivariate analysis (p < 0.001) but not after adjustment. Risk communication that addresses vaccine safety and effectiveness, rather than generic disease-awareness messaging alone, is likely to be most effec tive in improving mpox vaccine acceptance in this population, with unemployed and less-educated residents warranting targeting. As a pre-campaign baseline collected during an active outbreak, these findings can inform the vaccination response in the Western Region and preparedness in comparable peri-urban West African settings.

title: Persistence of Vaccinia Virus-Neutralizing Antibodies and Cross-Reaction Against Monkeypox Virus Decades After Smallpox Vaccination in an Italian Population
abstract: Background/Objectives: Routine smallpox vaccination ended after eradication, leaving uncertainty about the persistence of vaccinia virus (VACV)-neutralizing antibodies and their activity against the monkeypox virus (MPXV) responsible for the 2022 outbreak. We assessed both responses in an Italian serum-bank cohort. Methods: We analyzed sera collected in 2016–2022 from 287 individuals born in or before 1974, whose presumed vaccination status was inferred from birth year, and 100 individuals born in 1977–1982. Neutralization of VACV ACAM2000 and an Italian clade IIb MPXV isolate was measured using the 50% plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT50). We compared paired titers and calculated the proportions with titers ≥1:20, a putative threshold for VACV applied to MPXV for homogeneity, lacking any specific information. Results: In the earlier birth cohort, VACV-neutralizing antibodies were detected at titers ≥1:10 in 207/287 samples (72.1%) and MPXV-neutralizing antibodies in 137/287 (47.7%). Titers ≥1:20 were found in 121/287 (42.16%; 95% CI 36.59–47.94) for VACV and 68/287 (23.69%; 95% CI 19.14–28.94) for MPXV. MPXV titers were lower than paired VACV titers (p < 0.0001), and titers against the two viruses were positively correlated (Spearman’s rs = 0.90, p < 0.0001). All 100 sera from the younger birth cohort were negative for both viruses. Conclusions: VACV-neutralizing antibodies remained detectable in many individuals from cohorts likely vaccinated in childhood, including some individuals presumed vaccinated more than 60 years ago. Cross-neutralization of MPXV was less frequent and weaker. Integrated prospective investigations combining functional serology with T-cell responses in representative populations might be helpful for preparedness in case of deliberate release of variola virus. Real-world vaccine effectiveness data are crucial for epidemic emergency management of mpox.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the persistence of vaccinia virus-neutralizing antibodies and their cross-reactivity against monkeypox virus in an Italian population decades after smallpox vaccination. Sera from two cohorts were analyzed: one born in or before 1974 and presumed vaccinated in childhood, and another born in 1977–1982. Neutralization was measured using PRNT50 against VACV ACAM2000 and an Italian clade IIb MPXV isolate. Results showed that 72.1% of the older cohort had VACV-neutralizing antibodies, while 47.7% had MPXV-neutralizing antibodies. Titers ≥1:20 were observed in 42.16% for VACV and 23.69% for MPXV. MPXV titers were lower than VACV titers, and there was a strong positive correlation between the two. The authors conclude that VACV-neutralizing antibodies remain detectable in many individuals, including those vaccinated over 60 years ago, but cross-neutralization against MPXV is less frequent and weaker. These findings highlight the importance of real-world vaccine effectiveness data for managing mpox outbreaks and preparedness for variola virus release.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 背景/目标:常规天花 疫苗接种 在根除后结束,导致痘苗病毒 (VACV) 中和抗体的持久性及其针对造成 2022 年 暴发 的猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 的活性存在不确定性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们分析了 2016 年至 2022 年从 287 名出生于 1974 年或之前的个体(其假定的 疫苗接种 状态是根据出生年份推断)和 100 名出生于 1977 年至 1982 年的个体收集的血清。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 50% 空斑减少中和试验 (PRNT50) 测量 VACV ACAM2000 和意大利分支 IIb MPXV 分离株的中和作用。我们比较了配对滴度并计算了滴度 ≥1:20 的比例,这是 VACV 应用于 MPXV 的同质性推定阈值,但缺乏任何具体信息。
elements_zh.main_results: 在较早出生的队列研究中,在207/287个样本(72.1%)中检测到效价≥1:10的VACV中和抗体,在137/287个样本(47.7%)中检测到MPXV中和抗体。VACV 滴度≥1:20 的病例为 121/287 (42.16%;95% CI 36.59–47.94),MPXV 滴度≥1:20 的病例为 68/287 (23.69%;95% CI 19.14–28.94)。MPXV 滴度低于配对的 VACV 滴度 (p < 0.0001),并且针对两种病毒的滴度呈正相关 (Spearman’s rs = 0.90,p < 0.0001)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在许多可能在儿童时期接种过疫苗的 队列研究 个体中,仍然可以检测到 VACV 中和抗体,其中包括一些推测在 60 多年前接种过疫苗的个体。MPXV 的交叉中和作用频率较低且较弱。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 真实的疫苗有效性数据对于猴痘的疫情应急管理至关重要。将功能性 血清学 与代表性人群中 T 细胞反应相结合的综合前瞻性研究可能有助于为天花病毒的故意释放做好准备。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告具体限制或证据强度评估。

title: Human antibody combinations determined by epitope mapping of orthopoxvirus A33/A35 confer therapeutic protection in mice.
abstract: Human infections with mpox virus (MPXV) since 2022 have resulted in more than 188,000 cases reported globally as of June 2026, highlighting the urgent need for effective therapeutics. Here, we recruited smallpox vaccinees and donors with incidental vaccinia virus (VACV) exposure and isolated a panel of human anti-A33/A35 monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) from the latter using recombinant MPXV A35 as a cross-reactive bait. These mAbs recognized four distinct nonoverlapping epitopes (epitopes 1 to 4) and one composite epitope (epitope 3 + 4) on MPXV A35 and exhibited cross-reactivity against multiple orthopoxviruses (OPXVs). Cryo-electron microscopy structural analysis revealed that the high-affinity epitope 3 + 4 mAb HD15 engages an epitope at the A35 dimer interface that is conserved across OPXVs. Combinations of mAbs targeting nonoverlapping epitopes mediated synergistic, Fc-dependent neutralization in vitro; conferred therapeutic protection against lethal VACV challenge; and reduced viral burden and disease severity after MPXV challenge in mice. Together, these findings establish a single-antigen, multiepitope strategy for the development of broadly protective therapeutics against OPXVs.

title_zh: 通过 正痘病毒 A33/A35 表位作图确定的人抗体组合可为小鼠提供治疗保护。
source_body_en: Human infections with mpox virus (MPXV) since 2022 have resulted in more than 188,000 cases reported globally as of June 2026, highlighting the urgent need for effective therapeutics. Here, we recruited smallpox vaccinees and donors with incidental vaccinia virus (VACV) exposure and isolated a panel of human anti-A33/A35 monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) from the latter using recombinant MPXV A35 as a cross-reactive bait. These mAbs recognized four distinct nonoverlapping epitopes (epitopes 1 to 4) and one composite epitope (epitope 3 + 4) on MPXV A35 and exhibited cross-reactivity against multiple orthopoxviruses (OPXVs). Cryo-electron microscopy structural analysis revealed that the high-affinity epitope 3 + 4 mAb HD15 engages an epitope at the A35 dimer interface that is conserved across OPXVs. Combinations of mAbs targeting nonoverlapping epitopes mediated synergistic, Fc-dependent neutralization in vitro; conferred therapeutic protection against lethal VACV challenge; and reduced viral burden and disease severity after MPXV challenge in mice. Together, these findings establish a single-antigen, multiepitope strategy for the development of broadly protective therapeutics against OPXVs.

title: Estimating the transmission dynamics of Mpox in Saudi Arabia using case surveillance and a Bayesian SEIR model
abstract: Abstract This study aimed to estimate the population-level transmission dynamics of the 2023–2024 Mpox outbreak in Saudi Arabia, using surveillance data from 13 May 2023 to 8 February 2024, and to estimate key epidemiological parameters to inform targeted interventions and containment strategies. Case-based surveillance was integrated with dynamic modeling, and the 92% of confirmed cases with complete data were analyzed using a Bayesian SEIR model to estimate the effective reproduction number ( $$R_e$$ ), the observation-scaling parameter ( $$\rho $$ ), and the overdispersion parameter ( $$\phi $$ ). At the onset of the modelled period (13 May 2023), $$R_e$$ was estimated at 2.04 (95% CrI: 1.47–2.64), rose to a peak of 2.08 (95% CrI: 1.55–2.66) on 16 May 2023, and declined below the epidemic threshold ( $$R_e < 1$$ ) by 8 September 2023. The observation-scaling parameter, which links modelled incidence to reported cases, was estimated at $$\rho = 0.561$$ (95% CrI: 0.351–0.786). The overdispersion parameter was $$\phi = 3.141$$ (95% CrI: 2.479–3.877), with stable estimates. Cases were reported among individuals with travel histories and reported exposure to social settings, and the case series showed a concentration among men. The observed dynamics were consistent with the global Clade IIb outbreak context, connecting imported cases to local transmission. These findings underscore the role of human mobility and local transmission in Mpox dissemination within Saudi Arabia, emphasizing timely epidemiological monitoring to inform targeted interventions, containment strategies, and resource allocation.

title_zh: 使用案例 监测 和贝叶斯 SEIR 模型估计沙特阿拉伯 猴痘 的 传播 动态
source_body_en: Abstract This study aimed to estimate the population-level transmission dynamics of the 2023–2024 Mpox outbreak in Saudi Arabia, using surveillance data from 13 May 2023 to 8 February 2024, and to estimate key epidemiological parameters to inform targeted interventions and containment strategies. Case-based surveillance was integrated with dynamic modeling, and the 92% of confirmed cases with complete data were analyzed using a Bayesian SEIR model to estimate the effective reproduction number ( $$R_e$$ ), the observation-scaling parameter ( $$\rho $$ ), and the overdispersion parameter ( $$\phi $$ ). At the onset of the modelled period (13 May 2023), $$R_e$$ was estimated at 2.04 (95% CrI: 1.47–2.64), rose to a peak of 2.08 (95% CrI: 1.55–2.66) on 16 May 2023, and declined below the epidemic threshold ( $$R_e < 1$$ ) by 8 September 2023. The observation-scaling parameter, which links modelled incidence to reported cases, was estimated at $$\rho = 0.561$$ (95% CrI: 0.351–0.786). The overdispersion parameter was $$\phi = 3.141$$ (95% CrI: 2.479–3.877), with stable estimates. Cases were reported among individuals with travel histories and reported exposure to social settings, and the case series showed a concentration among men. The observed dynamics were consistent with the global Clade IIb outbreak context, connecting imported cases to local transmission. These findings underscore the role of human mobility and local transmission in Mpox dissemination within Saudi Arabia, emphasizing timely epidemiological monitoring to inform targeted interventions, containment strategies, and resource allocation.
abstract_zh: 摘要:本研究旨在利用 2023 年 5 月 13 日至 2024 年 2 月 8 日的 监测 数据,估计沙特阿拉伯 2023 年至 2024 年 猴痘 暴发 的人口水平 传播 动态,并估计关键流行病学参数,为有针对性的干预措施和遏制策略提供信息。基于病例的监测结合动态建模,使用贝叶斯SEIR模型对92%的完整数据的确诊病例进行分析,估计有效繁殖数( $$R_e$$ )、观测尺度参数( $$\rho $$ )和过度离散参数( $$\phi $$ )。在模型期开始时(2023 年 5 月 13 日),$$R_e$$ 估计为 2.04(95% CrI:1.47–2.64),于 2023 年 5 月 16 日升至峰值 2.08(95% CrI:1.55–2.66),并于 9 月 8 日降至流行阈值以下($$R_e < 1$$) 2023. 将建模的 发病率 与报告病例联系起来的观测尺度参数估计为 $$\rho = 0.561$$ (95% CrI: 0.351–0.786)。过度离散参数为 $$\phi = 3.141$$ (95% CrI: 2.479–3.877),估计值稳定。病例报告出现在有旅行史和接触过社交场合的个人中,病例系列显示集中在男性中。观察到的动态与全球 Clade IIb 暴发 背景一致,将输入病例与本地 传播 连接起来。这些发现强调了人员流动和当地 猴痘 在沙特阿拉伯境内 猴痘 传播中的作用,强调及时的流行病学监测,以便为有针对性的干预措施、遏制策略和资源分配提供信息。

title: Single-Step Sample-Activated Alternating Sequential Flow Enables Autonomous Multistep Electrochemical Lateral Flow Detection of Mpox Virus DNA.
abstract: The 2022 multinational mpox virus (MPXV) outbreak and continued cross-border transmission have highlighted limitations of laboratory-confined PCR diagnostics. Here, we report an alternating lateral flow architecture (ALFA) that transforms traditional single-pass lateral flow into a programmable platform for autonomous multistep electrochemical nucleic acid detection following a single prepared-sample introduction. By regulating passive fluid delivery, ALFA enables sequential molecular processing and in situ signal generation without external intervention. Coupled with Ag(I)-mediated mismatch DNA nanocomplexes (MDNs), the system provides electrochemical signal amplification without nucleic acid amplification. ALFA detected MPXV DNA with a limit of detection (LOD) of 1.55 pM and a linear range of 101-105 pM. In urine and saliva spiked with structurally intact viral particles, the lowest statistically distinguishable concentration was 10 copies mL-1. Clinical evaluation of 50 PCR-characterized lesion swab samples yielded 92.11% sensitivity, 100% specificity, and 94.0% accuracy. The platform also maintained stable performance over an estimated 112 days. ALFA therefore provides a programmable lateral flow framework for rapid, amplification-free, decentralized nucleic acid diagnostics.

The system uses Ag(I)-mediated mismatch DNA nanocomplexes (MDNs) for signal amplification without requiring nucleic acid amplification. ALFA demonstrated a limit of detection (LOD) of 1.55 pM and a linear range of 101-105 pM, with the lowest statistically distinguishable concentration in urine and saliva samples being 10 copies mL-1. title: Rubicon as an emerging regulator in the interplay between mpox virus infection and autophagy
abstract: Mpox virus (MPXV) has recently emerged as a major global public health concern, underscoring the need to better understand the molecular mechanisms governing virus–host interactions. Like other members of the Orthopoxvirus genus, MPXV relies extensively on host cellular pathways to complete its replication cycle while simultaneously counteracting cellular antiviral mechanisms. Among these host pathways, autophagy has attracted increasing attention because of its dual role in maintaining cellular homeostasis and restricting intracellular pathogens through lysosomal degradation. Recent evidence has identified Rubicon (RUN domain Beclin-1-interacting and cysteine-rich domain-containing protein) as a central regulator at the interface between autophagy and viral infection. By negatively regulating canonical autophagy while simultaneously participating in non-canonical pathways, Rubicon occupies a unique position in the control of intracellular membrane trafficking and innate immune responses. Importantly, a growing number of viruses have evolved mechanisms to exploit Rubicon-dependent pathways, highlighting this protein as a potentially conserved target of viral immune evasion. In this review, we summarize current knowledge of the interplay between orthopoxviruses and the autophagic machinery, with a focus on MPXV and Rubicon as a key negative regulator of autophagy and a potential modulator of viral pathogenesis. We also discuss the broader role of Rubicon in viral infections and consider its potential as a therapeutic target for the development of host-directed antiviral strategies.
journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology

source_body_en: Mpox virus (MPXV) has recently emerged as a major global public health concern, underscoring the need to better understand the molecular mechanisms governing virus–host interactions. Like other members of the Orthopoxvirus genus, MPXV relies extensively on host cellular pathways to complete its replication cycle while simultaneously counteracting cellular antiviral mechanisms. Among these host pathways, autophagy has attracted increasing attention because of its dual role in maintaining cellular homeostasis and restricting intracellular pathogens through lysosomal degradation. Recent evidence has identified Rubicon (RUN domain Beclin-1-interacting and cysteine-rich domain-containing protein) as a central regulator at the interface between autophagy and viral infection. By negatively regulating canonical autophagy while simultaneously participating in non-canonical pathways, Rubicon occupies a unique position in the control of intracellular membrane trafficking and innate immune responses. Importantly, a growing number of viruses have evolved mechanisms to exploit Rubicon-dependent pathways, highlighting this protein as a potentially conserved target of viral immune evasion. In this review, we summarize current knowledge of the interplay between orthopoxviruses and the autophagic machinery, with a focus on MPXV and Rubicon as a key negative regulator of autophagy and a potential modulator of viral pathogenesis. We also discuss the broader role of Rubicon in viral infections and consider its potential as a therapeutic target for the development of host-directed antiviral strategies.

title: Characterizing Mpox (Monkeypox) Spread in the Americas Using Retrospective Spreadsheet Approach for Nonexperts.
abstract: IntroductionThis study aimed to evaluate the spread of Mpox (monkeypox) during the 2022 outbreak in six countries across the Americas-Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, Peru, and the USA, using a simplified and accessible retrospective approach based on Microsoft Excel and non-expert analytical tools.MethodsWeekly confirmed Mpox case data were obtained from the Our World in Data repository between May and September 2022. For each country, Microsoft Excel was used to apply three trendline models, linear, quadratic, and exponential, to visualize and statistically assess case progression. Model fit and performance were rigorously evaluated using a comprehensive suite of evaluation metrics, including the coefficient of determination (R2), Mean Squared Error (MSE), Chi-square goodness-of-fit, and p-values.ResultsAcross the selected observation windows, the quadratic trendline provided the best in-sample fit among the three candidate functional forms in most countries in terms of R2 values. For instance, in Mexico, the quadratic model achieved an R2 of 0.987 compared to 0.882 (linear) and 0.888 (exponential). Similar trends were observed in the USA (R2 = 0.986 for quadratic vs. 0.852 linear, and 0.813), Brazil (0.978 vs. 0.752), and Colombia (0.947 vs. The chi-squared and Mean Squared Error (MSE) values supported these findings, with the quadratic model yielding lower errors and greater statistical significance in most cases (p < 0.001).ConclusionsAcross the selected observation windows, the quadratic trendline provided the best in-sample fit among the three candidate functional forms in most countries. These retrospective comparisons of descriptive curve fit findings provide practical value of the approach, in its accessibility and transparency for rapid trend characterization, though, is not a substitution for formally evaluated epidemic forecasting frameworks.
journal: Inquiry : a journal of medical care organization, provision and financing

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the spread of Mpox (monkeypox) during the 2022 outbreak in six countries across the Americas using a simplified and accessible retrospective approach based on Microsoft Excel and non-expert analytical tools.

These findings highlight the potential of using accessible tools for trend characterization, though the study acknowledges limitations in formal epidemic forecasting. elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 每周确认的 猴痘 病例数据是从 2022 年 5 月至 9 月期间从“我们的世界”数据存储库获得的。该研究重点关注巴西、智利、哥伦比亚、墨西哥、秘鲁和美国。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于使用非专家工具的回顾性方法,可能缺乏对流行病预测框架的正式评估。证据是中等的,因为结果是基于描述性曲线拟合而没有因果推断。

title: Maternal and neonatal mpox in Nigeria: a multicentre case series highlighting diagnostic challenges, transmission pathways, and neonatal outcomes
abstract: Mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period remains insufficiently characterised, particularly in endemic African settings. Maternal infection may go unrecognised, while neonatal disease can present early and require prolonged clinical care. We describe three mother–infant pairs managed in southern Nigeria, highlighting maternal recognition, possible transmission pathways, neonatal manifestations, and outcomes. We conducted a retrospective case series of three neonates with laboratory-confirmed mpox managed at three hospitals in southern Nigeria between January and May 2025. Cases were identified during routine clinical care following recognition of neonatal vesiculopustular illness and confirmation of monkeypox virus (MPXV) infection by real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) on lesion swabs. Maternal clinical histories, epidemiological information, investigations, management, and outcomes were retrospectively reviewed. Two developed fever and vesiculopustular eruptions in the third trimester, while the third had a brief febrile illness without a recognised rash one day before delivery. Maternal mpox was not recognised before delivery, and none of the women underwent MPXV testing. Two fathers had compatible illnesses following travel outside Rivers State, providing possible additional epidemiological links. All three male neonates developed fever and disseminated vesiculopustular eruptions between days 4 and 9 of life and presented to hospital between days 14 and 16. Neonatal lesion swabs were positive for MPXV by RT-PCR (cycle threshold values, 19.70–21.60), while varicella-zoster virus PCR results were negative. Management was primarily supportive. Tecovirimat was considered but was unavailable for clinical use in Nigeria during the study period. Two neonates recovered completely. The third died at home on day 24 of life following interruption of inpatient care. No post-mortem examination was performed; therefore, the immediate cause of death could not be established. The available evidence did not permit determination of the route of neonatal infection. These cases demonstrate how maternal illness compatible with mpox may remain unrecognised until neonatal disease prompts investigation. Early neonatal presentation, uncertainty about transmission pathways, and challenges sustaining inpatient care highlight important gaps in the recognition and management of mpox at the maternal–newborn interface. Improved clinical suspicion, timely molecular diagnosis, and continuity of care are important priorities in endemic settings.

analysis.summary_en: This review article presents a multicentre case series of three mother–infant pairs in southern Nigeria with laboratory-confirmed mpox. The study highlights the challenges in diagnosing maternal mpox, the uncertainty surrounding neonatal transmission pathways, and the variability in neonatal outcomes. Maternal mpox was not identified prior to delivery, and none of the women underwent MPXV testing. Neonatal cases presented with fever and disseminated vesiculopustular eruptions, with two recovering and one dying at home due to interrupted inpatient care. The study underscores the need for improved clinical suspicion, timely molecular diagnosis, and continuity of care in endemic settings. However, the lack of post-mortem examination and the inability to determine the route of neonatal infection represent significant evidence gaps.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 妊娠期和新生儿期的 猴痘 特征仍不充分,特别是在非洲流行地区。我们描述了在尼日利亚南部管理的三对母婴,重点介绍了母亲的认知、可能的 传播 途径、新生儿表现和结果。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 我们对 2025 年 1 月至 5 月期间在尼日利亚南部三家医院管理的三名实验室确诊的 猴痘 新生儿进行了回顾性病例系列。这些病例是在常规临床护理中识别新生儿水疱脓疱病并通过病灶拭子实时聚合酶链反应 (RT-PCR) 确认猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 感染后发现的。对母亲的临床病史、流行病学信息、调查、治疗和结果进行了回顾性审查。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 产妇 猴痘 在分娩前未被识别,并且所有妇女均未接受 MPXV 检测。所有三名男性新生儿均在出生后第 4 天至第 9 天出现发烧和播散性水疱脓疱疹,并在第 14 天至第 16 天期间入院。RT-PCR 检测新生儿病灶拭子 MPXV 呈阳性(循环阈值 19.70-21.60),而水痘带状疱疹病毒 PCR 结果呈阴性。管理层主要是支持的。两名新生儿已完全康复。第三名患者在住院治疗中断后于出生第 24 天在家中死亡。没有进行尸检;因此,无法确定直接死亡原因。现有证据无法确定新生儿感染途径。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 早期新生儿表现、传播 通路的不确定性以及维持住院护理的挑战凸显了母婴界面 猴痘 识别和管理方面的重要差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 改善临床怀疑、及时分子 诊断 和连续护理是流行病环境中的重要优先事项。

title_zh: 尼日利亚母胎猴痘在多中心病例系列中的诊断挑战、传播途径及新生儿结局
source_body_en: Mpox during pregnancy and the neonatal period remains insufficiently characterised, particularly in endemic African settings. Maternal infection may go unrecognised, while neonatal disease can present early and require prolonged clinical care. We describe three mother–infant pairs managed in southern Nigeria, highlighting maternal recognition, possible transmission pathways, neonatal manifestations, and outcomes. We conducted a retrospective case series of three neonates with laboratory-confirmed mpox managed at three hospitals in southern Nigeria between January and May 2025. Cases were identified during routine clinical care following recognition of neonatal vesiculopustular illness and confirmation of monkeypox virus (MPXV) infection by real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) on lesion swabs. Maternal clinical histories, epidemiological information, investigations, management, and outcomes were retrospectively reviewed. Two developed fever and vesiculopustular eruptions in the third trimester, while the third had a brief febrile illness without a recognised rash one day before delivery. Maternal mpox was not recognised before delivery, and none of the women underwent MPXV testing. Two fathers had compatible illnesses following travel outside Rivers State, providing possible additional epidemiological links. All three male neonates developed fever and disseminated vesiculopustular eruptions between days 4 and 9 of life and presented to hospital between days 14 and 16. Neonatal lesion swabs were positive for MPXV by RT-PCR (cycle threshold values, 19.70–21.60), while varicella-zoster virus PCR results were negative. Management was primarily supportive. Tecovirimat was considered but was unavailable for clinical use in Nigeria during the study period. Two neonates recovered completely. The third died at home on day 24 of life following interruption of inpatient care. No post-mortem examination was performed; therefore, the immediate cause of death could not be established. The available evidence did not permit determination of the route of neonatal infection. These cases demonstrate how maternal illness compatible with mpox may remain unrecognised until neonatal disease prompts investigation. Early neonatal presentation, uncertainty about transmission pathways, and challenges sustaining inpatient care highlight important gaps in the recognition and management of mpox at the maternal–newborn interface. Improved clinical suspicion, timely molecular diagnosis, and continuity of care are important priorities in endemic settings.
abstract_zh: 妊娠期和新生儿期的 猴痘 特征仍不充分,特别是在非洲流行地区。孕产妇感染可能无法被识别,而新生儿疾病可能很早就出现并需要长期的临床护理。我们描述了在尼日利亚南部管理的三对母婴,重点介绍了母亲的认知、可能的 传播 途径、新生儿表现和结果。我们对 2025 年 1 月至 5 月期间在尼日利亚南部三家医院管理的三名实验室确诊的 猴痘 新生儿进行了回顾性病例系列。这些病例是在常规临床护理中识别新生儿水疱脓疱病并通过病灶拭子实时聚合酶链反应 (RT-PCR) 确认猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 感染后发现的。对母亲的临床病史、流行病学信息、调查、治疗和结果进行了回顾性审查。两人在妊娠晚期出现发烧和水疱脓疱疹,而第三人在分娩前一天出现短暂的发热性疾病,但没有发现皮疹。产妇 猴痘 在分娩前未被识别,并且所有妇女均未接受 MPXV 检测。两名父亲在离开河流州旅行后患有相似的疾病,这提供了可能的额外流行病学联系。所有三名男性新生儿均在出生后第 4 天至第 9 天出现发烧和播散性水疱脓疱疹,并在第 14 天至第 16 天期间入院。RT-PCR 检测新生儿病灶拭子 MPXV 呈阳性(循环阈值 19.70-21.60),而水痘带状疱疹病毒 PCR 结果呈阴性。管理层主要是支持的。特考韦瑞 曾被考虑,但在研究期间无法在尼日利亚用于临床。两名新生儿已完全康复。第三名患者在住院治疗中断后于出生第 24 天在家中死亡。没有进行尸检;因此,无法确定直接死亡原因。现有证据无法确定新生儿感染途径。这些病例表明,在新生儿疾病促使调查之前,与 猴痘 相符的孕产妇疾病可能仍然未被识别。早期新生儿表现、传播 通路的不确定性以及维持住院护理的挑战凸显了母婴界面 猴痘 识别和管理方面的重要差距。改善临床怀疑、及时分子 诊断 和连续护理是流行病环境中的重要优先事项。

title: Clade I and Clade II monkeypox virus in Barcelona, 2025–2026: More similarities than differences in a case–case study
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Clade I is becoming more predominant in Europe and may differ epidemiologically from Clade II. METHODS: This case-case study (N=100) compared Clades I and II detected in Barcelona between September 2025 and June 2026. Crude and adjusted odds ratios (aOR) with 95% confidence intervals (95%CI) were estimated using logistic regression models. RESULTS: While the overall epidemiological profile and clinical severity were similar, Clade I cases were more likely to reside in lower-income districts, less likely to be migrants (aOR=0.34, 95%CI 0.25;0.47), and more frequently reported sexual activity during leisure activities(aOR=7.55, 95%CI 3.93;14.53), attendance at large-scale events(aOR=18.78, 95%CI 7.40;47.67). Clinically, Clade I cases showed higher odds of fever (aOR=1.55, 95%CI 1.05;2.28), odynophagia (aOR=5.13, 95%CI 2.98;8.85), oral rash (aOR=42.60, 95%CI 12.11;149.88) and generalized rash, whereas generalized lymphadenopathy (aOR=0.33, 95%CI 0.15;0.71) and anogenital rash (aOR=0.55, 95%CI 0.36;0.83) were less frequent. CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that Clade Ib circulation in urban settings currently mirrors the epidemiological patterns established by Clade IIb.
authors: Mpox Clade I–II Comparative Analysis Working Group Barcelona Spain

title_zh: 巴塞罗那克鲁伊和克鲁伊二型猴痘病毒,2025–2026年:一项病例-病例研究中更多相似性而非差异性
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Clade I is becoming more predominant in Europe and may differ epidemiologically from Clade II. METHODS: This case-case study (N=100) compared Clades I and II detected in Barcelona between September 2025 and June 2026. Crude and adjusted odds ratios (aOR) with 95% confidence intervals (95%CI) were estimated using logistic regression models. RESULTS: While the overall epidemiological profile and clinical severity were similar, Clade I cases were more likely to reside in lower-income districts, less likely to be migrants (aOR=0.34, 95%CI 0.25;0.47), and more frequently reported sexual activity during leisure activities(aOR=7.55, 95%CI 3.93;14.53), attendance at large-scale events(aOR=18.78, 95%CI 7.40;47.67). Clinically, Clade I cases showed higher odds of fever (aOR=1.55, 95%CI 1.05;2.28), odynophagia (aOR=5.13, 95%CI 2.98;8.85), oral rash (aOR=42.60, 95%CI 12.11;149.88) and generalized rash, whereas generalized lymphadenopathy (aOR=0.33, 95%CI 0.15;0.71) and anogenital rash (aOR=0.55, 95%CI 0.36;0.83) were less frequent. CONCLUSIONS: These findings suggest that Clade Ib circulation in urban settings currently mirrors the epidemiological patterns established by Clade IIb.

title: In silico design of a multiepitope vaccine candidate targeting the monkeypox virus L1R protein via sequence-based immunoinformatics
abstract: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is a zoonotic orthopoxvirus whose re-emergence poses a significant global health threat. The L1R protein, a highly conserved component of the intracellular mature virion (IMV) membrane, plays a critical role in viral entry and replication, making it a promising target for epitope-based vaccine design. In this study, an immunoinformatics-driven in silico approach was employed to design a structurally stable, non-toxic, and non-allergenic multi-epitope vaccine candidate derived from the MPXV L1R protein. Human protein homology screening using BLASTp confirmed the absence of significant similarity, thereby minimizing the risk of autoimmunity. Predicted cytotoxic T lymphocyte (CTL), helper T lymphocyte (HTL), and B-cell epitopes were linked using immunogenic linkers and adjuvanted with human β-defensin 3. The construct was evaluated for toxicity, allergenicity, three-dimensional structure, molecular docking with Toll-like receptors 2 (TLR2) and 4 (TLR4), structural stability, and immune response simulation. The optimized construct exhibited high predicted immunogenicity, safety, and structural robustness. Molecular docking analysis revealed strong binding affinity toward both TLR2 and TLR4, while immune simulations predicted robust activation of humoral and cellular immune responses. Collectively, these findings suggest that the proposed construct represents a promising next-generation vaccine candidate against orthopoxviruses and warrants further experimental validation.
journal: Journal of King Saud University – Science

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 是一种人畜共患 正痘病毒,其重新出现对全球健康构成重大威胁。L1R 蛋白是细胞内成熟病毒颗粒 (IMV) 膜的高度保守成分,在病毒进入和复制中发挥着关键作用,使其成为基于表位的 疫苗 设计的有前景的靶标。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在本研究中,采用免疫信息学驱动的计算机方法来设计源自 MPXV L1R 蛋白的结构稳定、无毒且无过敏性的多表位 疫苗 候选物。使用 BLASTp 进行人类蛋白质同源性筛选证实不存在显着的相似性,从而最大限度地降低自身免疫的风险。
elements_zh.methods: 使用免疫原性接头连接预测的细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞 (CTL)、辅助 T 淋巴细胞 (HTL) 和 B 细胞表位,并用人 β-防御素 3 佐剂。评估该构建体的毒性、过敏性、三维结构、与 Toll 样受体 2 (TLR2) 和 4 (TLR4) 的分子对接、结构稳定性和 免疫应答 模拟。
elements_zh.main_results: 分子对接分析显示对 TLR2 和 TLR4 都有很强的结合亲和力,而免疫模拟则预测体液和细胞 免疫应答 的强烈激活。优化的构建体表现出较高的预测免疫原性、安全性和结构稳健性。

title_zh: 通过基于序列的免疫信息学对针对猴痘病毒 L1R 蛋白的多表位 疫苗 候选物进行计算机设计
source_body_en: Monkeypox virus (MPXV) is a zoonotic orthopoxvirus whose re-emergence poses a significant global health threat. The L1R protein, a highly conserved component of the intracellular mature virion (IMV) membrane, plays a critical role in viral entry and replication, making it a promising target for epitope-based vaccine design. In this study, an immunoinformatics-driven in silico approach was employed to design a structurally stable, non-toxic, and non-allergenic multi-epitope vaccine candidate derived from the MPXV L1R protein. Human protein homology screening using BLASTp confirmed the absence of significant similarity, thereby minimizing the risk of autoimmunity. Predicted cytotoxic T lymphocyte (CTL), helper T lymphocyte (HTL), and B-cell epitopes were linked using immunogenic linkers and adjuvanted with human β-defensin 3. The construct was evaluated for toxicity, allergenicity, three-dimensional structure, molecular docking with Toll-like receptors 2 (TLR2) and 4 (TLR4), structural stability, and immune response simulation. The optimized construct exhibited high predicted immunogenicity, safety, and structural robustness. Molecular docking analysis revealed strong binding affinity toward both TLR2 and TLR4, while immune simulations predicted robust activation of humoral and cellular immune responses. Collectively, these findings suggest that the proposed construct represents a promising next-generation vaccine candidate against orthopoxviruses and warrants further experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 是一种人畜共患 正痘病毒,其重新出现对全球健康构成重大威胁。L1R 蛋白是细胞内成熟病毒颗粒 (IMV) 膜的高度保守成分,在病毒进入和复制中发挥着关键作用,使其成为基于表位的 疫苗 设计的有前景的靶标。在本研究中,采用免疫信息学驱动的计算机方法来设计源自 MPXV L1R 蛋白的结构稳定、无毒且无过敏性的多表位 疫苗 候选物。使用 BLASTp 进行人类蛋白质同源性筛选证实不存在显着的相似性,从而最大限度地降低自身免疫的风险。使用免疫原性接头连接预测的细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞 (CTL)、辅助 T 淋巴细胞 (HTL) 和 B 细胞表位,并用人 β-防御素 3 佐剂。评估该构建体的毒性、过敏性、三维结构、与 Toll 样受体 2 (TLR2) 和 4 (TLR4) 的分子对接、结构稳定性和 免疫应答 模拟。优化的构建体表现出较高的预测免疫原性、安全性和结构稳健性。分子对接分析显示对 TLR2 和 TLR4 都有很强的结合亲和力,而免疫模拟则预测体液和细胞 免疫应答 的强烈激活。总的来说,这些发现表明,所提出的构建体代表了对抗 正痘病毒 的有前途的下一代 疫苗 候选者,并值得进一步的实验验证。

title: Análise epidemiológica da mpox no século XXI: uma revisão narrativa Epidemiological analysis of mpox in the 21st century: a narrative review Análisis epidemiológico de la mpox en el siglo XXI: una revisión narrativa
abstract: A mpox ganhou relevância internacional após a ampliação do número de casos observada a partir de 2022, modificando o cenário epidemiológico anteriormente concentrado principalmente em regiões da África Central e Ocidental. Este estudo teve como objetivo analisar a evolução temporal da doença, o perfil sociodemográfico e clínico dos casos, os padrões de transmissão e as principais medidas de vigilância e controle. Foi realizada uma revisão narrativa da literatura, de caráter descritivo e abordagem qualitativa, com buscas entre fevereiro e outubro de 2026 em bases científicas e documentos institucionais. Os estudos analisados evidenciaram expansão internacional da mpox e, no Brasil, predominância de notificações entre pessoas registradas como do sexo masculino ao nascimento no período avaliado. No Brasil, 91,8% dos 8.167 casos confirmados e prováveis notificados entre 7 de junho e 1o de outubro de 2022 eram de pessoas do sexo masculino ao nascimento. Entre os casos para os quais havia informação sobre exposição, o contato sexual foi o tipo de contato mais frequentemente relatado, sem excluir outras formas de contato próximo. Os achados reforçam a necessidade de vigilância epidemiológica contínua, diagnóstico laboratorial oportuno, rastreamento de contatos, vacinação conforme as recomendações vigentes e comunicação em saúde baseada em evidências e livre de estigmatização.

Este estudo teve como objetivo analisar a evolução temporal da doença, o perfil sociodemográfico e clínico dos casos, os padrões de transmissão e as principais medidas de vigilância e controle. Foi realizada uma revisão narrativa da literatura, de caráter descritivo e abordagem qualitativa, com buscas entre fevereiro e outubro de 2026 em bases científicas e documentos institucionais. Os estudos analisados evidenciaram expansão internacional da mpox e, no Brasil, predominância de notificações entre pessoas registradas como do sexo masculino ao nascimento no período avaliado. No Brasil, 91,8% dos 8.167 casos confirmados e prováveis notificados entre 7 de junho e 1o de outubro de 2022 eram de pessoas do sexo masculino ao nascimento. Entre os casos para os quais havia informação sobre exposição, o contato sexual foi o tipo de contato mais frequentemente relatado, sem excluir outras formas de contato próximo. Os achados reforçam a necessidade de vigilância epidemiológica contínua, diagnóstico laboratorial oportuno, rastreamento de contatos, vacinação conforme as recomendações vigentes e comunicação em saúde baseada em evidências e livre de estigmatização.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the mpox virus, examining its epidemiological evolution, sociodemographic and clinical profiles, transmission patterns, and surveillance and control measures. The central question is to understand the global spread of mpox and its characteristics in specific populations, particularly in Brazil.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative analysis of the literature, conducted between February and October 2026, using scientific databases and institutional documents. It is descriptive and qualitative in nature, without explicit mention of meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The studies highlight the international expansion of mpox and note that in Brazil, the majority of confirmed and probable cases were reported among individuals assigned male sex at birth. Sexual contact was the most frequently reported mode of exposure, though other close contacts were also noted.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence does not report on specific controversies or evidence gaps related to the mpox virus. However, the review suggests a need for further research on transmission dynamics and the role of different populations in disease spread.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings emphasize the importance of continuous epidemiological surveillance, timely laboratory diagnosis, contact tracing, vaccination according to current guidelines, and evidence-based health communication that avoids stigmatization.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review analyzes the epidemiological evolution of mpox, focusing on its global spread and specific characteristics in Brazil. The review highlights the predominance of male sex at birth among reported cases and the frequent association of sexual contact with transmission. It underscores the need for ongoing surveillance, prompt diagnosis, contact tracing, and evidence-based public health communication to manage the disease effectively.

title: Healthcare Workers’ Preparedness for Monkeypox Pandemic Response in SubSaharan Africa: A Rapid Review Investigating the Knowledge Gap
abstract: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.
journal: Journal of Clinical Virology and Translational Research

analysis.summary_en: This rapid review examines healthcare workers' (HCWs) preparedness for monkeypox (Mpox) pandemic response in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). The review highlights that only 46.8% of HCWs have adequate knowledge about Mpox, despite its high case fatality rate in the region. Barriers to preparedness include reliance on social media for information and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention are associated with higher knowledge levels, but these attitudes do not translate into clinical preparedness, indicating an intention-action gap. The review underscores the need for peer-reviewed information sources and a structured One Health training framework to address these gaps. The findings suggest that targeted training and policy interventions are essential to improve HCW readiness for Mpox outbreaks in SSA.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 猴痘 是一种人畜共患病毒性疾病,由撒哈拉以南非洲 (SSA) 流行的 正痘病毒 引起,该病的死灰复燃凸显了卫生保健工作者 (HCW) 迫切需要加强做好准备。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 遵循系统评价和荟萃分析的首选报告项目 (PRISMA) 指南,使用 MeSH 术语和布尔运算符对 2000 年至 2024 年间发表的研究进行 PubMed 和 ScienceDirect 搜索。纳入了评估 HCW 知识、态度或 SSA 中 猴痘 准备情况的研究,并提供英文或法文全文;那些涉及非医护人员人群、在 SSA 之外进行或缺乏主要数据的研究被排除在外。两名评审员使用标准化模板独立筛选和提取数据;使用 JBI 分析横断面研究批判性评估清单评估质量。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 纳入了来自 388 份记录的五项研究(喀麦隆、埃塞俄比亚、尼日利亚、刚果民主共和国;n = 1,672 名医护人员)。只有 46.8% 的医护人员表现出足够的 猴痘 知识。障碍包括对社交媒体的依赖和获得正规培训的机会有限。对预防的积极态度与较高的知识水平相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尽管该地区的病死率接近全球平均水平的十倍,但只有不到一半的 SSA 医护人员表现出足够的 猴痘 知识;积极态度并未转化为临床准备,反映了严重的意向与行动差距;社交媒体作为信息来源占据主导地位,强调了在同一个健康培训框架内需要经过同行评审的替代方案。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 本快速审查综合了 HCW 的知识、态度、信息来源以及 SSA 中 猴痘 准备障碍的证据,以确定培训需求和政策影响。

title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区医护人员应对猴痘大流行的准备情况:快速回顾调查知识差距
source_body_en: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.

title: Synthesis and Structure-Activity Relationship (SAR) of Hydroxypyridone-3-carboxamides against Orthopoxviruses.
abstract: We have previously identified hydroxypyridone-3-carboxamide 4a as a potent antiviral hit against vaccinia virus (VACV) and monkeypox virus (MPXV), albeit with extremely low solubility. Herein, we have conducted antiviral structure-activity relationship (SAR)-directed and solubility-driven synthesis of a total of 57 analogs. In the primary VACV reporter assay, many analogs demonstrated nanomolar to sub-micromolar antiviral potency without significant cytotoxicity, with analog 4m showing 10-fold improved potency. Plaque assays against VACV and MPXV confirmed the strong antiviral activities. We also discovered that amide N-methylation drastically enhanced solubility via disrupting an intramolecular H-bond. Specifically, we identified an N-methylated analog (4f) with >1000-fold improved solubility while retaining potency (EC50 = 0.69 μM). In addition, compound 4f exhibited dose-response potency against MPXV in the plaque assay and highly favorable ADME properties. Overall, our current work characterizes 4f as a strong antiviral lead and solidifies amide N-methylation as a viable approach toward further lead development.

title: MicroDUET: a dual-headed genomic foundation model for pathogen surveillance
abstract: Pathogen genomic surveillance works from raw reads, assembled genomes and alignments, representations that are slow and costly to compare at scale. Compact embeddings from genomic language models offer an alternative, but surveillance requires resolving both evolutionary ancestry (phylogeny) and phenotypic capability (function) - which need not co-vary. Here we present MicroDUET, which adapts a 26.6-million-parameter ProkBERT backbone with two 3.5-million-parameter adapter heads: a phylogeny head trained contrastively on genome windows from the same microbes, and a function head trained to identify genes across taxa. On held-out retrieval benchmarks, the phylogeny head returned the correct species for 80.3% and 66.6% of cellular and viral queries, and the function head the correct gene family for 97.3% and 97.2%, reaching 74.4% accuracy on an independent antimicrobial resistance-class benchmark. Across all three benchmarks MicroDUET outranked 17 other genomic encoders. Without training on lineage, clade or drug-susceptibility tasks, MicroDUET identified Mycobacterium tuberculosis and mpox virus lineages and clades (0.965, 0.975 accuracy), discriminated rifampicin resistance without lineage adjustment (AUROC 0.985), and retrospectively identified an emerging mpox lineage as anomalous (AUROC 0.974). MicroDUET operates 10^3 - 10^4 times faster than single-threaded sequence-based alignments. MicroDUET therefore provides a compact, reusable representation for scalable pathogen surveillance and sequence triage.
